draftNotice.title: DRAFT POLICY – SUBJECT TO FINAL APPROVAL & LEGAL REVIEW
draftNotice.message: Important: The following customer policies are proposed drafts prepared for management approval and legal review under applicable Indian consumer-protection and e-commerce laws. They remain non-binding until final operational alignment and legal ratification.

brandTagline: Fine Jewellery. Fair Value. Generations of Trust.

policies.title: 14-Day Exchange Policy
policies.summary: Exchange eligible gold, diamond, and polki jewellery within 14 days of delivery at 100% of the original invoice value without any deduction.
policies.proposedPromise: Exchange within 14 days at 100% of the original invoice value, without any deduction, for eligible gold, diamond and polki jewellery.
terms: The 14-day period begins on the date of delivery recorded by the delivery provider.
The original invoice or verifiable purchase record must be provided.
The jewellery must be returned in its original, undamaged and unaltered condition, with applicable certificates, packaging and accessories.
Gold, diamond and polki jewellery will be assessed under the relevant category-specific verification process by our in-house gemologists.
Custom-made, personalised, engraved and specially commissioned jewellery may be excluded, provided the exclusions are disclosed before purchase and remain subject to applicable law.
The exchange value will be adjusted against an eligible replacement purchase. This policy does not promise a cash refund for a change of mind.
Any statutory consumer rights and remedies under Indian law remain unaffected.
Customers must contact customer support or visit our Jaipur showroom to initiate an exchange and receive return shipping instructions.
policies.operationalNote: Define the treatment of discounted products, missing certificates, gifts, bundled purchases, damaged packaging and category-specific exceptions before launch. No deduction should be applied to an otherwise eligible exchange promised at 100% of invoice value.

policies.title: Lifetime Buyback Policy
policies.tagline: A Relationship That Lasts Beyond the Purchase
policies.summary: Lifetime buyback assistance for eligible jewellery based on real-time gold rates and documented stone valuation methodology.
policies.proposedPromise: We aim to provide lifetime buyback assistance for eligible jewellery purchased from Jai Sri Ram Jewellers, subject to physical verification and documented valuation methodology.
goldComponent: The jewellery will be assessed for authenticity and purity using certified assaying methods.
Eligible net metal weight will be determined, strictly excluding stones, wax, enamel, non-metal components and other excluded material.
The gold component will be valued using the applicable gold rate on the date of buyback, for the verified purity (22K 916 / 18K 750) and net weight.
Any applicable processing deductions, if adopted, must be clearly defined in the final policy and disclosed before the transaction.
stoneComponent: Stones will be assessed separately for type, authenticity, condition and relevant specifications (4Cs for diamonds, syndicate quality for polki).
Any value offered for stones will be based on the brand's documented valuation methodology and assessment of the individual item.
Stone valuation is separate from metal valuation and is not automatically equal to the original invoice value.
Where a stone cannot be reliably valued or accepted, the customer must be informed transparently before the transaction is completed.
additionalTerms: Original invoice and available certificates (GIA, IGI, BIS) may be requested to help verify the product.
Jewellery may be subject to non-destructive ultrasonic and XRF inspection and testing.
The customer will receive the itemised proposed valuation breakdown before accepting the buyback.
Buyback is subject to applicable Indian law, government-mandated identity verification (PAN / Aadhaar where required), and internal acceptance procedures.
Any payment will be made through an approved traceable bank payment method (NEFT / RTGS / Cheque) after completion of verification and acceptance.
The lifetime buyback promise does not mean a guaranteed return of the original purchase price or making charges, taxes (GST) or promotional discounts.

policies.title: Lifetime Maintenance & Repairs
policies.summary: Lifelong complimentary inspection, ultrasonic cleaning, and prong checks, alongside transparently quoted repair services.
policies.proposedPromise: Eligible jewellery purchased from Jai Sri Ram Jewellers may be presented for maintenance assessment throughout its lifetime.
terms: Complimentary Services: Visual inspection, ultrasonic cleaning, steam cleaning, and prong tightness checks are provided complimentary for life.
Repairs, replacement stones, additional gold materials, resizing, and structural alterations may attract nominal charges.
All charges must be communicated clearly and approved by the customer before any work begins.
Normal wear and tear, accidental damage, missing stones and unauthorised alterations by third-party jewellers may not qualify for complimentary repairs.
Certain intricate designs, vintage jadau settings, or delicate enamelling construction methods may limit the repairs possible.
Customers should retain invoices and available certificates for swift verification.

policies.title: Shipping & Insured Delivery Policy
policies.summary: 100% insured, trackable delivery across India with tamper-evident packaging and delivery OTP verification.
terms: Ready-to-Ship products are dispatched within 2 to 4 business days.
Made-to-Order and bespoke bridal commissions are dispatched within 14 to 21 business days with personal concierge updates.
All shipments are 100% insured until physical delivery OTP verification at your address.
Deliveries are fulfilled in tamper-evident security boxes via specialized high-value logistics partners (e.g., Sequel Logistics, BVC Logistics, BlueDart Apex).
Customers must inspect the outer security seal upon delivery and decline acceptance if tampering is evident.
For any delivery delays or discrepancies, our dedicated concierge team resolves issues within 24 hours.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.summary: Hassle-free cancellation on ready orders before dispatch; transparent terms for customized orders.
terms: Ready-to-ship orders may be cancelled at no fee at any time before dispatch.
Custom-made, engraved, or bespoke jewellery may be cancelled within 24 hours of order placement before gold casting begins.
Approved refunds are processed back to the original payment source within 5 to 7 business days.
Statutory rights under Indian consumer regulations are fully respected.

policies.title: Damaged, Defective or Incorrect Orders
policies.summary: Dedicated priority protocol for any order issues reported within 48 hours of delivery.
terms: Please notify our support team within 48 hours of delivery with photographs or unboxing video of the affected item.
We arrange complimentary insured reverse pickup from your doorstep.
Upon physical inspection and verification, customers are provided an immediate replacement or full adjustment per applicable law.

policies.title: Quality & Authenticity Assurance
policies.summary: BIS Hallmark with 6-digit HUID on all gold; natural certified diamonds and genuine syndicate polki.
terms: 100% of gold jewellery is BIS Hallmarked with unique 6-digit HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) laser engraved.
Diamonds are certified natural stones with IGI / GIA laboratory dossiers specifying colour, clarity, cut, and carat.
Polki jewellery is set using genuine uncut natural diamonds in 24K gold foil (Jadau technique).
Precise gross weight, net gold weight, and stone carat are documented on tax invoices.
Every transaction maintains permanent digital records to facilitate future lifetime maintenance and buyback.

policies.title: Privacy, Payments & Terms
policies.summary: End-to-end encrypted transactions, RBI-compliant payment gateways, and stringent customer privacy standards.
terms: Payment transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption via RBI-approved payment gateways (Razorpay, Net Banking, UPI, Cards).
We never store full card numbers, CVVs, or banking credentials on our servers.
Customer personal details are used strictly for order fulfillment, insurance, and customer relationship communications.
Compliant with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) standards.

policies.title: Grievance Redressal
policies.summary: Dedicated officer and direct escalation pathway in accordance with Indian Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.
terms: Grievance Officer: Customer Redressal Desk, Jai Sri Ram Jewellers
Address: Jai Sri Ram Jewellers Showroom, Johari Bazar / M.I. Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001, India
Email: grievance@jaisriramjewellers.com / support@jaisriramjewellers.com
